title: Frame properties of the silent embedding
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, with distinguished index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside its image, and let $M$ be an $m$-tape machine. For any initial configuration, background tape contents and head positions, prefix, initial output, and time $t$, every tape index outside the image of $\iota$ and different from $\mathrm{cap}$ retains its initial tape contents and head position after $t$ steps of the silent embedding. The input-head position agrees with that of $M$ after $t$ steps, and the output remains the initial output.

The distinguished index $\mathrm{cap}$ is outside the image of $\iota$
